name: Profiling
description: Find out why something is slow by measuring it: time a command over several runs and keep the history, or see where a Node or Python program spends its time as a flame chart.
agent: Profiling: profile_time (time a command, compared with last time), profile_where (where a Node or Python program spends its time), profile_history. Measure before guessing why something is slow, and after a change meant to speed it up.

intro.tagline: Finds out why something is slow, by measuring it.
intro.what: When something is slow, guessing why often gets it wrong. This times a command over several runs and keeps the results, so you can see if a change made it faster. For JavaScript and Python programs it also shows which parts take the time, as a colourful chart.
helps: Fixes are aimed at the real cause, not a guess.
A history shows whether things are getting faster or slower.
The chart makes the slow part easy to see.
intro.example: The build feels slow. Prism times it (42 seconds), finds most of it is spent shrinking pictures, fixes that, and times it again: 18 seconds.
